results.remarks: **PRICED TO SELL!** Experience elevated townhome living in the heart of Downtown’s prestigious Marina District within the coveted Park Row community. This exceptional second-story residence welcomes you with rich hardwood floors, soaring ceilings, and an airy open-concept design that blends sophistication with warmth. The expansive living room is illuminated by oversized windows and skylights, while a striking walnut-trimmed fireplace with art tile detailing creates an elegant focal point. A versatile dining area flows seamlessly into the timeless kitchen, thoughtfully appointed with custom black walnut cabinetry, quartz countertops, gas cooking, and refined finishes throughout. Oversized sliding glass doors extend the living space outdoors to a private balcony, where city views stretch toward Seaport Village and the Bay, an ideal setting for effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining. A custom-designed staircase leads to a bright, architectural loft featuring a built-in executive office for two (or bedroom), complete with solid wood desks, extensive bookcases, and integrated storage. A second set of sliding doors opens to an exclusive rooftop deck—perfect for sunset views and starlit evenings above the city. The private primary suite offers a tranquil retreat with a generous jetted soaking tub and a recently remodeled spa-inspired shower. Additional highlights include central air conditioning, in-unit laundry, recessed lighting, and abundant storage.  Park Row residents enjoy lush park-like grounds adorned with sparkling fountains, a resort-style pool and spa, secured underground parking, 24-hour gated security, and ample guest parking, all just moments from waterfront dining, Seaport Village, The Rady Shell, Petco Park, the Gaslamp Quarter, the Convention Center, Balboa Park, and San Diego International Airport. A rare opportunity to enjoy refined townhome living in one of Downtown’s most distinguished locations.

results.remarks: Point Loma coastal living at its best! Welcome to 3549 Shoreline Bluff Lane, a beautifully appointed end-unit townhome in the desirable gated community of At The Bay. This spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers approximately 1,386 SF with no neighbors above or below for added privacy. The open-concept floor plan features abundant natural light, a cozy fireplace, central A/C, and a private covered balcony perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas, creating an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining.  Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with en-suite bath and ample closet space. Additional highlights include full-size laundry, abundant storage, and an attached two-car tandem garage with workshop space and direct entry.  Enjoy resort-style community amenities including a pool, spa, clubhouse, and playground. Ideally located just minutes from Liberty Station, Shelter Island, Mission Bay, beaches, shopping, dining, downtown San Diego, and major freeways.  With its prime Point Loma location, desirable end-unit privacy, generous living space, low HOA dues, and exceptional amenities, this is a fantastic opportunity to enjoy the San Diego coastal lifestyle in one of the area's most sought-after neighborhoods.

results.remarks: Discover this bright, corner two-bedroom residence in Horizons with sweeping downtown city views. Beautifully updated, the open-concept great room is wrapped in floor-to-ceiling windows and features newer flooring, quartz countertops, stainless-steel Bosch appliances, wine fridge, and sleek electric shades. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a spa-like bath with an oversized soaking tub, separate walk-in shower, and dual vanity. The second bedroom is currently an office, but can easily accommodates a queen bed.  Step out to the private balcony to enjoy a glass of wine while overlooking the city, children’s park and seasonal fireworks. Unit includes TWO parking spaces and a dedicated storage unit.  Ideally located in the heart of the Marina District, Horizons is a lush urban oasis with resort-style amenities that include a pool, fitness center, recreation and conference rooms, BBQ area, lounge, 24-hour security/concierge, and 15 guest parking spaces. Enjoy easy walking access to cafés, restaurants, parks, Seaport Village, transit, scenic waterfront paths and so much more! This is an exceptional opportunity to own a turnkey retreat in one of Downtown's most desirable neighborhoods and buildings. results.remarks: Experience uncompromised peace of mind, ultimate privacy, and resort-style living at The Discovery in Cortez Hill. High-rise living in downtown San Diego is at its absolute finest when backed by a dedicated 24/7 front desk security guard and concierge team—ensuring total access control so guests cannot simply walk into the building unannounced.  Adding to the incredible strength of this HOA, your monthly dues deliver incredible value by covering gas, water, high-speed Wi-Fi/internet, sewer, and trash pickup—meaning your only utility responsibility is electricity! Residents enjoy a premier suite of luxury amenities, including a 10th-floor rooftop lap pool and hot tub with panoramic skyline views, a fully equipped fitness center, sauna, steam room, and a social lounge. Hosted building events throughout the year foster a warm, welcoming community feel.  Positioned on the desirable 5th floor, Unit 511 is a rare 3-bedroom southwest corner home featuring an expansive great room framed by dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows, soaring 10-foot ceilings, a cozy fireplace, and commanding mountain and city views. Unlike the standard 2-bedroom inventory flooding the market, this spacious 1,285 sq ft floor plan provides the versatile space modern buyers demand—making it ideal for remote executives, corporate tenants, or families alike. The fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar seating flows seamlessly into the living spaces and out onto an oversized private terrace, perfect for outdoor dining, lounging, and a BBQ. results.remarks: If you lived here, you could potentially eliminate your car expenses. Everything you need is within walking distance! Refreshed kitchen with Samsung stainless appliance package including washer/dryer, both bathrooms fully renovated with modern finishes and an extra wide soaking tub. This beautifully modernized unit no longer gives 2002 vibes like most other units in the development do. Thoughtfully designed dual-primary layout offers maximum flexibility and privacy, ideal for roommates, guests, or a work-from-home setup. You've seen those typical 1-car garages where you weren't sure how you'd get out of your car after parking? Not here! This 19'x9'x10' oversized garage even allows for overhead storage racks. In addition, you receive 2 parking permits for reserved spots. An e-bike will take you to the beach in under 3 miles, and your feet will take you everywhere else you need to go. Easy access to the 56, 5, and 805 freeways makes for an effortless commute for when you must leave paradise. This is coastal, low-maintenance living done right!

results.remarks: Seller will consider a 2/1 Rate Buy Down! Rarely available two-story residence at ICON, offering a true townhome-style floor plan in the Ballpark District of Downtown San Diego's East Village. Spanning 1,454 square feet across two levels, this 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home delivers what few downtown residences can: genuine separation between living and sleeping space. Both bedroom suites are privately situated on the upper level, while the main floor opens to a light-filled living and dining area, a private balcony, kitchen, and a guest powder room. Full-size in-unit laundry, central air and heat, and two garage parking spaces complete the residence.  ICON offers some of the most extensive amenities downtown, including a 1,700-square-foot fitness center, a private movie theater, the 5th Inning Lounge with a full kitchen, a landscaped courtyard, 24-hour lobby attendants with a staffed package room, and secure underground parking. The centerpiece is the rooftop SkyBox, a viewing terrace with BBQs, heaters, and lounge seating set just 820 feet from Padres home plate, offering a direct sightline into Petco Park along with sweeping views of the Rady Shell, San Diego Bay, the Coronado Bridge, and the Pacific beyond Coronado. ICON's association was named Community Association of the Year by the Community Associations Institute's San Diego chapter and hosts resident catamaran outings, happy hours, and an annual holiday party.  What sets the Ballpark District apart is how much of the city is simply within reach. Petco Park and Gallagher Square sit directly across the street, close enough to grab a last-minute ticket an hour before first pitch and be home minutes after the final out, while everyone else is still waiting to get out of the garage. Concerts at the ballpark and the Rady Shell work the same way: no parking, no rideshare, no drive home. Fit Athletic's flagship club, with its rooftop pool and cold plunges, is just across 10th Avenue. Michelin-recognized Callie, steakhouse Cowboy Star, KOS Coffee, IZOLA bakery, and Neighborhood (home to two speakeasy bars, one ranked among North America's best) are all within a few blocks, along with dozens more restaurants, cafés, and bars. The trolley is one block away, coworking spaces are within walking distance, and the Embarcadero and the bay are a ten-minute walk.   Luxury. Location. Lifestyle. Welcome home.

results.remarks: Welcome to Mission Valley living at its best! This beautifully updated, turnkey two-story townhome is located in the highly desirable gated Rio Del Oro community, offering an exceptional blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Upstairs, you’ll find two spacious bedrooms, each featuring a private full bathroom and generous closet space. The inviting living room offers a cozy wood-burning fireplace, while the separate dining area provides an ideal setting for everyday meals or entertaining. The thoughtfully updated kitchen and all bathrooms were renovated in 2020, with kitchen appliances also replaced that year. The main level features stylish luxury vinyl flooring, complemented by plantation shutters throughout the home. The washer and dryer were replaced in 2025. A versatile bonus room provides additional flexibility and can be used as a home office, guest room, workout space, or creative studio. Step outside to your spacious, sunny private patio—perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying San Diego’s beautiful year-round weather. Beyond your front door, Rio Del Oro offers a community pool and spa, fitness center, beautifully landscaped grounds, and a dedicated dog park. Residents also enjoy convenient access to the scenic San Diego River Trail and Riverwalk, providing opportunities for walking, jogging, biking, and enjoying the outdoors right in the heart of Mission Valley.

results.remarks: VA approved complex. Fully remodeled and move-in ready, this Scandinavian-inspired UTC townhome offers dual en-suite bedrooms with heated bathroom floors, designer finishes throughout, and a quiet location within the highly desirable La Jolla Village Park community.  Offering 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and approximately 1,368 square feet, this exceptionally spacious home combines modern comfort, thoughtful design, and an unbeatable location in the heart of University City.  The fully renovated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, under-cabinet lighting, and sleek contemporary finishes. Luxury vinyl plank flooring flows throughout the home, complemented by updated lighting, shaker-style doors, and carefully selected European fixtures and finishes. The inviting living room is anchored by an upgraded gas fireplace with marble and split-face travertine surround.  Designed for both comfort and functionality, both upstairs bedrooms feature private en-suite bathrooms with heated floors and remodeled floor-to-ceiling tile showers. The spacious primary suite offers generous closet space with custom barn doors and a spa-inspired bathroom featuring dual vanities, and a walk-in shower. The secondary bedroom enjoys its own private south-facing balcony.  Energy-efficient Anlin windows and sliding doors installed throughout provide exceptional sound reduction and year-round comfort. Additional highlights include an attached one-car garage with epoxy flooring, added loft storage and shelving, an on-site parking permit for a second vehicle/guests, an oversized laundry room with full-size washer and dryer, and extensive improvements completed throughout the home.  Residents of La Jolla Village Park enjoy a pool, spa, sauna, tennis courts, racquetball courts, greenbelts, and beautifully maintained common areas. HOA dues cover hot and cold water, sewer, trash, exterior maintenance, and landscaping.  Ideally located just moments from UTC's premier Westfield shopping, dining, grocery stores, fitness centers, movie theaters, UC San Diego, the trolley, La Jolla Village, La Jolla Shores, Torrey Pines, downtown San Diego, and San Diego International Airport.   Offering the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and low-maintenance living, this thoughtfully remodeled home is an exceptional opportunity in one of San Diego's most desirable communities.

results.remarks: Experience the best of Marina District living in this stylish south-facing residence at Renaissance, where panoramic water and city views pair beautifully with an exceptionally spacious floor plan. The wraparound L-shaped balcony showcases sweeping south and west vistas of the bay, downtown skyline, and iconic Coronado Bridge, creating a spectacular backdrop for everyday living and entertaining. Inside, oversized windows flood the home with natural light and accentuate the travertine flooring that flows throughout the open living spaces. The galley kitchen features granite countertops and stainless appliances. The large bedrooms are a standout feature rarely found in Downtown living. The primary suite serves as a true retreat, offering dual closets and a spa-inspired bath complete with a soaking tub, step-in shower, and dual vanity. The spacious guest bedroom is equally impressive, highlighted by oversized picture windows and ample room to comfortably accommodate guests, a home office or both! Two desirably located side-by-side parking spaces and a private storage unit add everyday convenience. Also enjoy proximity to the future life science and biotechnology research development The Research and Development District (The RaDD) at the Embarcadero and the sustainable tech-focused Campus at Horton in the center of the city. Delight in the casual elegance of Renaissance amidst the convenience of sophisticated urban living.  Renaissance common areas have been recently refreshed and refurbished and include staffed lobbies, 24/7 security, pool & spa, barbecues, lounge areas, an outdoor fireplace, a well-equipped fitness center, and meeting rooms. Don’t miss your chance to call this special residence your own!

results.remarks: Residence 1704 at Aria presents a rare opportunity to experience elevated San Diego living from a 17th-floor northwest corner residence. Offering 1,355 sq. ft., 2 bedrooms and 2 baths, this exceptional home is wrapped in expansive corner windows that capture extraordinary natural light and panoramic views in three directions. The ever-changing panorama extends from the lush greenery of Balboa Park across San Diego Bay to the Downtown skyline and Coronado Bridge, with dramatic sunsets over Point Loma. The coveted northwest orientation provides abundant natural light throughout the day while helping minimize the heat and glare of the stronger midday and early-afternoon sun.  The views are not limited to the living spaces—they are enjoyed from the kitchen, both bedrooms and even the bathrooms. The living and dining areas open seamlessly to a covered terrace, creating a private outdoor extension of the home. It is an ideal setting for morning coffee, sunset cocktails or effortless entertaining against a backdrop of bay sunsets, illuminated city lights and aircraft quietly approaching San Diego International Airport.  Inside, the residence has been thoughtfully refreshed for a sophisticated, move-in-ready experience. Brand-new premium flooring offers the refined appearance of light wood with commercial-grade durability, while both bedrooms feature brand-new carpeting. Fresh interior paint throughout creates a crisp, pristine backdrop.  (see supplemental comments!)  The contemporary kitchen pairs sleek European-style cabinetry with dark stone countertops, stainless-steel appliances and an expansive peninsula that opens naturally to the living and dining areas—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The desirable split-bedroom floor plan provides excellent privacy, and the primary bath features dual vanities and a walk-in shower. An in-unit washer and dryer add convenience.  The location within Aria is equally impressive. Positioned at the southern end of SR-163, the building provides immediate access to San Diego's regional freeway network, while Residence 1704 faces away from the freeway and remains remarkably quiet. Two assigned parking spaces on the first garage level offer quick entry and exit with unusually easy maneuvering. The residence is just steps from the elevator, making arrivals with groceries or luggage effortless while remaining comfortably removed from elevator noise. With only four residences sharing the 17th floor, the home enjoys an additional level of privacy. A private, secure storage space is also included.  Aria delivers the advantages of full-service high-rise living with an uncommon sense of community. Attentive management, professional staff, controlled access and concierge service complement a collection of amenities designed for both relaxation and connection, including a heated pool and spa, fitness center, resident lounge, conference room, event space and dedicated bicycle storage. Impeccably maintained common areas complete the experience.  Set in Cortez Hill, Residence 1704 places the best of San Diego within easy reach while maintaining a peaceful residential atmosphere. Balboa Park is close by for morning walks and runs, gardens, museums, theater and cultural events. Little Italy, the Gaslamp Quarter, the waterfront and San Diego's beaches are all nearby, and San Diego International Airport is just minutes away. The result is a uniquely balanced lifestyle: the city's culture, dining, entertainment, nature and connectivity are remarkably close, yet the energy and congestion of the city remain outside your door. Residence 1704 combines sweeping views, sophisticated updates, exceptional convenience and the quiet refinement of one of Aria's most desirable corner locations.

results.remarks: Photographs only tell part of the story. The true scale and depth of these panoramic views are impossible to appreciate until experienced in person.  Located in Cortez Blu, this 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence in Downtown San Diego's Cortez Hill neighborhood offers 1,217 square feet with some of the finest panoramic views in Downtown San Diego. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame a sweeping 180-degree panorama from the Coronado Bridge and Coronado Islands across the downtown skyline and San Diego Bay to the Pacific Ocean and sunsets over Point Loma. To the north, Balboa Park unfolds beneath the skyline, anchored by the iconic blue-and-gold tiled California Tower.  Inside, new luxury vinyl plank flooring, exposed architectural concrete walls and ceilings, a neutral interior ready for your personal vision, and a brand-new, never-used oven/range and microwave create a refined industrial aesthetic with room to make it your own. A spacious balcony off the living room and a private balcony off the primary suite offer two outdoor spaces to enjoy the views.  Cortez Hill is known for its peaceful residential character and commanding views over Downtown San Diego, offering a unique balance of tranquility and urban convenience.  Residences with views this expansive, this much living space, and this level of value seldom come to market. Thoughtfully priced, this home delivers a luxury lifestyle without the luxury price tag—making it one of Downtown San Diego's most compelling values.

results.remarks: RARELY AVAILABLE PARK VIEW 2BR PLUS LOFT overlooking beautiful Pantoja Park!........THIS IS THE LARGEST FLOOR PLAN IN PARK ROW...ONLY 7 OF THESE UNITS ARE DIRECTLY ON THE PARK!  (Not fronting the streets or the trolley!) Flooded with light through upgraded Milgard windows and sliders, 17' ceilings and a large skylight.  Cross ventilation galore brings in the cool breezes off iconic San Diego Bay which is only 2 blocks away!! This fully remodeled gem has new wide-plank engineered hardwood floors, contemporary kitchen with premium stainless appliances and gorgeous custom quartz counters. Spacious primary suite accommodates a king bed and has a large customized closet. Both bathrooms are remodeled with custom tile and quartz counters. In unit washer/dryer. Upstairs loft is open to the living room below...use it as the 3rd BR, home office for a work-from home lifestyle, or as a guest space or a den. Loft has beautiful built-in storage closets with adjustable shelving...suitable for hanging clothes. Park facing balcony is perfect for your morning coffee, al fesco dining & BBQ...also features a storage closet & garden hose spigot for easy cleaning and watering your potted garden!  Resort-like pool, spa and clubhouse! 20 guest parking spaces! Move-in ready! See supplement for more info.  Park Row has 222 units and only 44 are the highly prized 2BR/2BA + loft floor plans. (These are the largest floor-plans in Park Row) Of these 44 units only 7 directly face Pantoja Park....So Unit 4 is a rare offering indeed overlooking San Diego's oldest City park....not fronting the public streets & sidewalks!  Located in the quiet and upscale Marina District where it's a short hop in every direction to the Bay, Convention Center, Little Italy, Seaport Village, trolley & AMTRAK. Only ten minutes to San Diego Airport.  Park Row's 222 units are built on 3 square blocks totaling over 6 acres....this is stunningly low density when compared to nearly all other Downtown developments. The result is not only a generous apportionment of the grounds to gardens but unheard of space for the resort like pool, spa, clubhouse facility and guest parking. Stroll through the walkways of Park Row and enjoy the variety of trees and flowering plants...each courtyard has it's own unique garden & fountain style.   Park Row is adjacent to Pantoja Park on G Street. Residents enjoy direct security gate access to the complex from this beautiful park. Pantoja Park is also the perfect place to take your dog for a walk and meet the neighbors! All units in Park Row come with one assigned parking space in the underground lot. Residents can rent an additional parking space for $60/month from the HOA. Ask agent about parking rules. Generous guest parking in the outside lot adjacent to clubhouse. Each unit has a small storage cabinet in the garage. Bike cage and bike "vaults" are available for rent from the HOA at a nominal cost. 10 SDG&E car chargers can be found in the gated community garages.

results.remarks: Showcasing true pride of ownership, this model-ready southwest corner residence at Savina delivers refined luxury in one of Downtown's most sought-after waterfront settings. Expansive windows bathe the interior in natural light framing city & bay views while the west-facing balcony becomes your front-row seat to San Diego’s unforgettable sunsets and evening skyline glow. The open-concept interior is finished with engineered wood flooring, designed for both comfort and entertaining. The gourmet kitchen features premium Thermador stainless appliances, discreet cabinet-front refrigerator, designer tile backsplash, and a striking quartz waterfall island. The primary suite includes a generous walk-in closet, spa-inspired bathroom with dual vanities and a walk-in rain shower. Both bedrooms are large enough to fit king beds and are outfitted with blackout shades. Overlooking Savina’s tranquil and tropical-inspired, courtyard featuring pool, spa, cascading waterfall and all the accoutrements for luxury-resort living, this residence has it all! Additional features include a sizable storage space (4th floor) and secured parking space (P2). All of this is located within one of Downtown’s most sought-after full-service developments, just moments from waterfront parks, the charm of Little Italy, and the very best of San Diego’s coastal urban lifestyle.  Savina by Bosa is one of San Diego’s newest high-rise buildings located just steps away from Little Italy, listed as one of Forbes “Best Neighborhoods.” Savina’s first-class amenities include amazing outdoor pool and spa, fitness center with outdoor yoga deck, steam room & sauna, dog wash and pet park, bicycle repair room, and club house/game room with BBQ deck for entertaining. Literally steps away from Waterfront Park, enjoy an array of concerts and outstanding local events. When it’s time to get away, take advantage of your close proximity to the airport, cruise terminal, and train/trolley stations. Whether winding down on the private balcony or making your way to one of Little Italy’s countless renowned restaurants, Savina is city living at its finest.

results.remarks: Rendezvous presents a rare opportunity to purchase new construction in North Park, one of San Diego’s most sought-after urban communities. This contemporary 2-bed, 2.5-bath, two-story condominium offers an exceptional layout with dual primary bedrooms, each featuring walk-in closets and ensuite baths with dual sinks. A rare 500 sq. ft. private outdoor courtyard extends the living space, while added north-facing windows in the dining room, primary bedroom, and primary bathroom enhance natural light throughout. The home features 10-ft ceilings, central heat and air, tankless water heating, and a modern open-concept design. Residents enjoy a secure building with fob/key access, two assigned parking spaces in the subterranean garage, and a pet-friendly community set within an exciting, highly walkable neighborhood close to dining, shopping, and everyday conveniences.  Discover Rendezvous, an exclusive collection of 35 newly built condominium homes in the heart of North Park. Kitchens are appointed with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, central waterfall islands, and stainless-steel appliances. Bathrooms include custom cabinets, quartz countertops, and satin brass fixtures. Homes offer stackable laundry closets or dedicated laundry rooms, and most include private balconies or terraces. Pre-wiring for security systems is also included. Rendezvous presents a rare opportunity to purchase new construction in North Park, one of San Diego’s most sought-after urban communities.
